text:
Maria: Heads-up — opened a PR to update the function/tool-calling docs with clearer JSON output examples and guardrail patterns. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 Please review for accuracy and snippets. Two main things I noticed: 1) the Python SDK snippet still shows the old call style, needs Redwood SDK pattern, 2) the structured-output example's schema doesn't match the sample response (missing `tool_result` wrapper). cc @Sophia @Nate
Sophia: Looking now. Do we have test prompts for the examples? :eyes:
Nate: I can run the examples against the latest runtime. FYI there was a small envelope change — tool responses are now under `tool_result` instead of `output`. I'll add a note in the PR and run smoke tests on Dedicated.
AJ: If the examples change, we need both Python and JS SDK snippets updated. I can take the JS side. @Sophia do you want Python?
Sophia: Yep. I'll update Python to show `from redwood import Client` usage and `client.call_tool(...)`. Also will add a minimal `jsonschema.validate` example for readers.
Maria: Thanks. Also left inline comments for two broken links in the guardrails section (link to eval harness and SDK ref).
deploy-bot: CI: docs build passed — 3 warnings (links) — https://ci.redwood.com/build/4231
AJ: Drafted a JS snippet as a comment in the PR. Quick question — do we prefer non-streaming snippets for the main examples? I think non-streaming is clearer for docs.
Sophia: Agreed — non-streaming for the primary examples, streaming as an "advanced" section with a short note.
Nate: Smoke tests: after switching to `tool_result` both Python and JS examples produced valid JSON that validate against the updated schema. Edge-case: when tools return `null` for optional fields, jsonschema fails unless `nullable` or `oneOf` is used. Suggest adding `"nullable": true` for tool args that can be null.
Maria: :thumbsup: Can we include a migration note: "If you previously parsed the raw string, switch to the structured `tool_result` path and run schema validation. Example migration script included." I can draft that blurb in the PR.
AJ: LGTM. Once snippets are in, I can merge after one more tech review. Who's on final sign-off?
Nate: I'll do final sign-off after CI passes on Dedicated. ETA ~2h.
Maria: I'll squash commits and add changelog entry `docs: clarify tool-calling output + add schema examples` before merge.
Sophia: Pushed Python snippet to branch `docs/tooling-json-guardrails` and added a tiny jsonschema snippet: `from jsonschema import validate
validate(instance=response['tool_result'], schema=TOOL_SCHEMA)` plus the fixed links.
AJ: Merging now (after Nate's sign-off).
deploy-bot: Docs site deploy started: https://deploys.redwood.com/docs/5678 — expected ~3 min
Maria: Deployed and spot-checked. Links fixed, examples render correctly. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
